email.body1:
Gretchen, saw Celigo ship Ora and the new Agent Builder, plus the 2026 Gartner Visionary nod for iPaaS.

Launches like that usually open more in-market accounts than a commercial team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Gretchen, quick follow-up for Celigo.

With new AI capabilities driving demand, most commercial teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Gretchen, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other iPaaS sellers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Gretchen, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your commercial motion? I'll tailor it to Celigo either way.
